name: Hanako Ikezawa
source:
After 10 years of social isolation, Hanako's new-found experience of being in a romantic relationship has caused her to start rethinking her previous outlook on life, friendships and the future and has made her determined to strengthen both her romantic bond with Hisao as well as her sibling-like bond with Lilly.

But life can be unpredictable, friendships can be complicated and the future still has several challenges in store for her.
